after: Obstacles may fall at two different fixed speeds. Each newly spawned obstacle is independently selected to be either a normal obstacle falling at 200 px/s or a fast obstacle falling at 300 px/s.
Each newly spawned obstacle is independently selected as:
- Normal obstacle: 50% probability, red, falling speed 200 px/s
- Fast obstacle: 50% probability, dark red or purple, falling speed 300 px/s
The two obstacle types must be visually distinguishable.

before: Each obstacle is a hazardous 40 × 40 px block that spawns at a random horizontal position and moves vertically downward at a fixed speed.
after: Each obstacle is a hazardous 40 × 40 px block that spawns at a random horizontal position and moves vertically downward at one of two fixed speeds.
Each new obstacle independently has:
- 50% probability of being a normal obstacle with falling speed 200 px/s.
- 50% probability of being a fast obstacle with falling speed 300 px/s.
Normal obstacles use red.
Fast obstacles use dark red or purple so that the two types are visually distinguishable.
Once an obstacle is spawned, its assigned type and falling speed remain unchanged until it is removed.
- Change their assigned falling speed.
Each new obstacle is independently assigned one type:
- 50% probability: normal obstacle, 200 px/s
- 50% probability: fast obstacle, 300 px/s

before: Each obstacle moves vertically downward at a fixed speed of 200 px/s.
Obstacles do not move horizontally, track the player, accelerate, or change speed.
after: Each obstacle moves vertically downward at the fixed speed assigned when it is spawned:
- Normal obstacle: 200 px/s
- Fast obstacle: 300 px/s
An obstacle's assigned speed does not change during its lifetime.
Obstacles do not move horizontally, track the player, or accelerate.

before: The game does not include differently sized obstacles, special obstacles, obstacle acceleration, or increasing difficulty.
after: The game does not include differently sized obstacles, additional special obstacles, obstacle acceleration, or increasing difficulty.

before: If the player's rectangle overlaps any obstacle rectangle, the game immediately enters `game_over`.
after: If the player's rectangle overlaps any normal or fast obstacle rectangle, the game immediately enters `game_over`.
Both obstacle types have the same collision consequence.

before: The obstacle spawn timer advances continuously. Exactly one obstacle is created whenever the fixed 1-second spawn interval is reached, and each active obstacle moves downward at 200 px/s.
after: The obstacle spawn timer advances continuously. Exactly one obstacle is created whenever the fixed 1-second spawn interval is reached. Its type is selected using the defined 50% / 50% probability, and it moves downward at its assigned speed.
- Normal obstacle falling speed: 200 px/s
- Fast obstacle falling speed: 300 px/s
